title: G-Quadruplexes Abet Neuronal Burnout in ALS and FTD.
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold V3建模TDP-43与G-四链体-血红素复合物的结合，属于蛋白质-核酸互作的结构建模，但对象为RNA/DNA GQ而非典型TF-DNA体系，方法上仅用AF3预测，未深入结合位点或动态机制，故为中档匹配。
abstract: Expansion of d(GGGGC)(n) repeat in the C9ORF72 gene is causal for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) and Frontal Temporal Dementia (FTD). Proposed mechanisms include Repeat-Associated Non-AUG translation or the formation of G-quadruplexes (GQ) that disrupt translation, induce protein aggregation, sequester RNA processing factors, or alter RNA editing. Here, I show, using AlphaFold V3 (AF3) modeling, that the TAR DNA-binding protein (TDP-43) docks to a complex of GQ and hemin. TDP-43 methionines lie over hemin and likely squelch the generation of superoxide by the porphyrin-bound Fe. These TDP-43 methionines are frequently altered in ALS patients. Tau protein, a variant of which causes ALS, also binds to GQ and heme and positions methionines to detoxify peroxides. Full-length Tau, which is often considered prone to aggregation and a prion-like disease agent, can bind to an array composed of multiple GQs as a fully folded protein. In ALS and FTD, loss-of-function variants cause an uncompensated surplus of superoxide, which sparks neuronal cell death. In Alzheimer's Disease (AD) patients, GQ and heme complexes bound by beta-amyloid 42 (Abeta4) are also likely to generate superoxides. Collectively, these neuropathologies have proven difficult to treat. The current synthesis provides a framework for designing future therapeutics.
abstract_zh: C9ORF72基因中d(GGGGC)(n)重复序列的扩增是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（Frontal Temporal Dementia, FTD）的致病原因。提出的机制包括重复相关非AUG翻译（Repeat-Associated Non-AUG translation）或G-四链体（G-quadruplexes, GQ）的形成，这些GQ可破坏翻译、诱导蛋白质聚集、隔离RNA加工因子或改变RNA编辑。在此，我通过AlphaFold V3（AF3）建模表明，TAR DNA结合蛋白（TDP-43）对接至GQ与hemin的复合物。TDP-43的甲硫氨酸残基位于hemin上方，可能抑制卟啉结合Fe生成超氧化物。这些TDP-43甲硫氨酸在ALS患者中经常发生改变。Tau蛋白（其一种变异体导致ALS）也结合GQ和heme，并定位甲硫氨酸以解毒过氧化物。全长Tau（通常被认为易于聚集并具有类朊病毒疾病因子特性）可作为完全折叠的蛋白质结合由多个GQ组成的阵列。在ALS和FTD中，功能缺失变异导致超氧化物过剩且无法补偿，从而引发神经元细胞死亡。在阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's Disease, AD）患者中，由β-淀粉样蛋白42（Abeta4）结合的GQ和heme复合物也可能生成超氧化物。总体而言，这些神经病理学疾病已被证明难以治疗。当前的综合分析为设计未来治疗策略提供了框架。
